AK-101 Unique.Description: A modern approach to the PPSh using an AK platform results in a surprisingly effective weapon firing an otherwise obsolete battlefield caliber
AK-101 Unique.Explanation:
AK-101 >SMG & WWII<
This unique variant replicates PPSh stats and caliber, but with zero recoil

M4A1 Unique.Description: Miracle of U.S. engineering. Someone wanted to have a BiS M4 so here it is
M4A1 Unique.Explanation:
M4A1 >7.62x51 Meta<
This unique variant provides meta-tier stats and is chambered with 7.62x51mm using X-17 magazines

Vector 9x19 Unique.Description: What do you call a weapon with M4 caliber, higher fire rate than an M4, and M4 magazines? A 5.56 Vector
Vector 9x19 Unique.Explanation:
Vector 9x19 >5.56x45 Speedy<
This unique variant increases fire rate and is chambered with 5.56x45mm using M4A1 magazines

SVT-40 Unique.Description: A toy gun for adults. Please do not choke on the magazine!
SVT-40 Unique.Explanation:
SVT-40 >Blicky<
This unique variant allows the use of the Blicky Special Magical Unbelievable Magazine, compatible with all matching calibers

MP-155 Unique.Description: Anti-materiel shotgun - because rifles are for cool kids, but shotguns are for chads!
MP-155 Unique.Explanation:
MP-155 >Sniper AMR<
This unique variant fires 12.7x108mm using a custom magazine and AXMC barrel for improved accuracy

AK-545 Unique.Description: We hope this variant finally satisfies everyone who couldn't choose between automatic fire and marksman precision
AK-545 Unique.Explanation:
AK-545 >Automatic Marksman<
This unique variant blends the best traits of Automatic and Marksman variant types. It supports all fire modes, increased fire rate, reduced recoil, 2-round bursts, and cannot malfunction

M870 Unique.Description: The M870, but with enough firepower to politely ask entire squads to disappear
M870 Unique.Explanation:
M870 >Karabin Spetsialniy & Buckshot Launcher<
This variant combines full-magazine-per-click firing, extremely reduced recoil, 23x75mm ammo, and a special 12-round magazine

PPSh-41 Unique.Description: The PPSh for people who think 'high capacity' means 'several thousand'
PPSh-41 Unique.Explanation:
PPSh-41 >Actually Endless<
This variant features a special magazine holding nearly 5,000 rounds with zero heat buildup

AK-50 Unique.Description: We upgraded your AK-50 to an AK-74 at no additional cost - and with significantly fewer engineering delays
AK-50 Unique.Explanation:
AK-50 >Real AK<
This unique variant adopts most of its statistics from the AK-74

Mosin Sniper Unique.Description: The 'gun of shoulder destruction' - now in an even more >Unheard< edition
Mosin Sniper Unique.Explanation:
Mosin Sniper >The Unheard Edition & AMR & Hypersonic & No-Bolt<
This unique variant is chambered in 12.7x108mm, uses The Unheard Edition magazines, has massive visible recoil, functions as a DMR, and features extreme muzzle velocity
